name: Health Equity Tracker
what_it_is: Open-source data platform that aggregates and visualizes US health disparity data across race, ethnicity, sex, socioeconomic status, and geography. Covers COVID-19, HIV, chronic disease, maternal health, community safety, and social determinants.
constraints: No secrets in .env files (checked into git)
Terraform doesn't auto-diff Cloud Run service contents
New python packages require Dockerfile and requirements.in updates
